name: MacBook Air 13" Intel 2018
chip: Intel Core i5 (8th gen) - Y-series, 2 cores
commonIssues: Butterfly keyboard failure - covered by Apple's Keyboard Service Program for 4 years from purchase
Battery swelling (8 years old in 2026 - extremely common)
Thermal throttling under sustained load
USB-C / Thunderbolt 3 port wear
Trackpad cable failure after spills
timelineNotes: Screen 2 days. Battery same-day. Butterfly keyboard requires top-case swap (1 day).
honestyNote: Eight years old in 2026. Battery swap (AED 590) is almost always worth it. Screen and butterfly-keyboard repairs together push past the value of a used M1 Air - we'll show you the math at intake.
heroTagline: The first Retina Air. We still keep these alive - when it's worth it.

name: MacBook Air 13" Intel 2019
commonIssues: Butterfly keyboard failure - Apple Keyboard Service Program eligible
Battery swelling (7 years old)
True Tone display flicker / backlight failure
USB-C port wear
Speaker rattle under heavy bass
timelineNotes: Screen 2 days. Battery same-day. Top-case (with butterfly keyboard) 1 day.
honestyNote: Same butterfly-keyboard issues as 2018. Apple's Keyboard Service Program may still apply if you're within 4 years of purchase - we'll check eligibility free, no cost if you qualify with Apple.
heroTagline: The True Tone Air. Battery and keyboard fixes make it useful again.

name: MacBook Air 13" Intel 2020
chip: Intel Core i3 / i5 / i7 (10th gen)
commonIssues: Magic Keyboard (scissor) - far more reliable, occasional key failures
Severe thermal throttling - passive heatsink, no real fan contact on the i7
Battery wear at 5+ years
USB-C port damage
macOS Sequoia is the LAST supported macOS - no Tahoe / future updates
timelineNotes: Screen 2 days. Battery same-day. Keyboard via top-case 1 day.
honestyNote: The last Intel Air - and famously the slowest. Battery swap is a no-brainer. If you need anything more than that, seriously consider stepping up to a used M1 Air; the performance gap is enormous and the M1 Air costs less to keep running.
heroTagline: The last Intel Air. Honest fixes, honest advice about when to move on.

name: MacBook Air 13" M1
commonIssues: Battery wear at 4-5 years (very common 2026)
Magic Keyboard key failures (scissor, isolated keys)
Trackpad cable failure after liquid contact
USB-C / Thunderbolt port damage
Single-fanless design - fanless cooling means dust packs into the heat spreader
timelineNotes: Screen 2 days. Battery same-day. Top-case (keyboard) 1 day.
honestyNote: The single best repair-value MacBook in our workshop. M1 performance still feels modern in 2026, parts are abundant, and the design is forgiving to work on. A AED 450 battery swap buys you 2-3 more years easily.
heroTagline: The M1 Air - the laptop that aged best. We keep it modern.

name: MacBook Air 13" M2
commonIssues: Magic Keyboard key failures
Liquid Retina screen - laminated panel, expensive replacement
MagSafe 3 connector debris / pin wear
Notched display backlight issues after impact
256GB base SSD is single-NAND - slower and harder to chip-recover
timelineNotes: Screen 2-3 days. Battery same-day. Logic board 3-5 days.
honestyNote: First Air with the new flat-edge design and the return of MagSafe. Very repairable, parts widely available. If you have the 256GB base model, be aware the SSD is single-NAND - back up regularly.
heroTagline: The redesigned Air. MagSafe is back. We service it like it's new.

name: MacBook Air 15" M2
commonIssues: Hinge wobble / hinge crack - known issue on early 15" units
Larger screen = more expensive replacement
Magic Keyboard key failures
MagSafe 3 connector debris
256GB single-NAND SSD
timelineNotes: Screen 2-3 days. Battery same-day. Hinge repair 1-2 days.
honestyNote: The first ever 15-inch Air. Most issues we see are hinge-related - Apple acknowledged some early units; bring proof of purchase, we'll check warranty status first.
heroTagline: The first 15-inch Air. Big screen, careful hinge work.

name: MacBook Air 13" M3
commonIssues: Magic Keyboard key failures (rare)
Liquid Retina screen impact damage
MagSafe 3 pin wear
USB-C / Thunderbolt port damage
Wi-Fi 6E intermittent connection on certain access points
timelineNotes: Screen 2-3 days. Battery same-day. Logic board 3-5 days.
honestyNote: Very few problems in the field. Apple finally moved the 256GB base back to dual-NAND, so SSD speed and recoverability are good across the range. Worth repairing for years to come.
heroTagline: The mature M3 Air. Few issues, easy fixes when needed.

name: MacBook Air 15" M3
commonIssues: Hinge wobble - improved over M2 15" but still occasional

MagSafe 3 connector debris

timelineNotes: Screen 2-3 days. Battery same-day. Hinge work 1-2 days.
honestyNote: The 15" Air matured nicely with M3. Hinge issues are far rarer than the M2 15". Repairable across the board with widely available parts.
heroTagline: Big-screen Air, fewer issues. Built to keep working.
